patterns.note: Asymmetrical content blocks are used frequently, pairing large, impactful text on one side with illustrative graphics or detailed cards on the other, creating dynamic visual balance.
The brand name and key headings utilize an oversized, bold, sans-serif typography that dominates the page, establishing a strong, almost brutalist, visual identity.

A muted, light background palette (#e1e5ea) provides a clean canvas, sharply contrasted by deep dark text (#0d1217) and vibrant, almost neon-like accent colors (greens, yellow, red) used for highlights, icons, and CTAs.
The hero section's large brand name text scales down and transforms into the logo within the sticky navigation bar as the user scrolls down the page.
Prominent use of large, bold numerical statistics and clearly numbered step-by-step process sections are used to convey authority and simplify complex information.

technique_notes: The hero section features a large, full-width brand name that dynamically scales down and repositions itself into the sticky header as the user scrolls. This transformation is accompanied by the initial hero background scrolling away to reveal the main content area. This effect likely uses GSAP ScrollTrigger to animate properties like font-size, position, and opacity based on scroll progress.

Content sections are full-width with generous vertical padding, creating distinct content blocks. Within these blocks, content often uses a two-column layout, with one side featuring large, impactful text and the other side containing illustrative graphics or smaller detail cards.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold sans-serif headings (especially the hero text, ~5x body) create a strong visual hierarchy, complemented by clear, legible body text.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners are used for interactive elements like buttons and cards, maintaining a modern yet approachable feel.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy spacing is used throughout, with particularly generous vertical padding between major sections and a tighter grid for feature cards.

standout: The most distinctive design element is the dynamic hero text that scales down and transforms into the sticky navigation logo upon scroll, creating a memorable brand introduction. This, combined with the oversized, bold typography for the brand name, gives the site a unique, almost brutalist, yet modern and professional feel.
